test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a misspelt word.

For every __endeavour__ - whether in the area of __career__, __academics__, music, sports or even in spirituality, it is a long __ardous__ journey.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **ardous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "ardous" is misspelt and should be **"arduous".**
 
• The correct word is **"arduous"**, which means requiring a lot of effort; very difficult. (कठिन, श्रमसाध्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The team faced an arduous journey through the mountains.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Endeavour** (प्रयास): An attempt to achieve a goal.

 
 
• **Example:** She is making every endeavour to improve her skills.
 
 
 
• **Academics** (शैक्षणिक): Related to education and scholarship.
 
 
• **Example: **He has always excelled in academics.
 
 
 
• **Career** (कैरियर): An occupation undertaken for a significant period of a person's life.
 
 
• **Example:** She pursued a career in medicine.
